question: Explain the meaning of cost centre and cost unit. State the different types of cost centres.
sources: Basic cost concepts: cost object, cost centre and cost unit

points.label: Meaning of cost centre
points.description: A cost centre is a location, person, item of equipment or group of these for which costs are collected and used for cost control.
points.basis: Cost concepts: definition of cost centre

points.label: Meaning of cost unit
points.description: A cost unit is a unit of product, service or time in relation to which costs are measured, for example per tonne of steel, per passenger-km or per job.
points.basis: Cost concepts: definition of cost unit

points.label: Personal and impersonal cost centres
points.description: A personal cost centre is a person or group of persons; an impersonal cost centre is a location or item of equipment.
points.basis: Cost concepts: classification of cost centres

points.label: Production and service cost centres
points.description: Production cost centres convert raw material into products; service cost centres help production centres, such as stores, maintenance and power house.
points.basis: Cost concepts: classification of cost centres

points.label: Operation and process cost centres
points.description: An operation cost centre groups machines or people doing the same operation; a process cost centre covers a continuous sequence of operations.
points.basis: Cost concepts: classification of cost centres
